story.title: Dino in the house
paragraphs_en: It was six in the evening and Ravi was walking back to his house with his friend, Mohan. They had finished their exam's and were walking home which was a couple of kilometers away from their tution and they had to pass through a forest. while they were in the forest the heard a loud wail and they ran towards the sound and at the sight they found something which Mohan fainted after seeing. It was a .....................................

A mother Dinosaur was wailing and was half dead. There was an egg right next to it. The mother dinosaur breathed her last breath. Mohan just woke up from his shock and told Ravi," Buddy! do you see what I see? Ms. Malhotra taught us that dino's were extinct long ago." "Apparently not," said Ravi with his eyes still glued at the mother dinosaur."I think we should take the egg with us Mohan" said Ravi with concern in his eyes . "yes! you are right" said Moh an. Then they heard the hatching of the egg and they were watching closely. Then a few second later, came a baby dinosaur from the egg.

The baby dinosaur was blue in color. It was nearly one foot tall with a long tongue and blunt teeth compared to the mother dinosaur. Ravi and Mohan ran home holding the younger dinosaur which was quite heavy, they quickly took him home, hid him in the basement of Ravi's house and Mohan took off to his house and came back with his sister Mina.

Mina was as suprised as Mohan when he saw the dinosaur for the first time. She asked Ravi and Mohan where the found him and whether their parents knew. Ravi's parents were very strict and so were Mohan's parents.."absolutely not, they won't agree to pet him. We are keeping him a secret". The three of them decided to make the Dino their pet and they will feed him at regular intervals with their own pocket money. They decided to name him Tommy.

Since they wanted to keep Tommy a secret, they took him for walks very early in the morning or late at night. The dinosaur grew very quickly and the children started running out of pocket money. After a few months, it grew very big to keep in the basement and when it grew 7 feet, Mohan thought that we should take him to the jungle and play there with him because the city was to dangerous for them as they may be spotted and Tommy would be killed.

They played in the forest hoping it would make a difference, but unfortunately a group of archaeologists found Tommy and reported it to the the main branch. The following day it was on the newspaper, but the kids tore the news paper so that they do not know about Tommy. They had to part with Tommy to save him.

﻿﻿﻿ ﻿ The kids had a long debate on whether Tommy should leave, Mina was on the verge of tears but Ravi and Mohan convinced her that it was for Tommy. They started moving towards the jungle with Tommy sneakily and quickly. Right then came a cop who started shooting at Tommy but it did not have an effect on Tommy he broke the policeman's car and the kids stopped the cop from shooting Tommy and proceeded to the jungle. Bade him goodbye to save and start Tommy's new life. they had tears in their eyes and they had only one picture in their mind. it ﻿was of
